name: four_category_disagreement
description: The target transaction has candidates classified into all four answer categories, with non-correct tie rules exercised while both control transactions remain ready.

transactions.prompt: What is the main benefit of unit tests?
Why must validators verify message signatures?
Why does deterministic ordering matter in consensus?

answers.scenario-03-control-before: Unit tests detect regressions early and make behavior safer to change.
answers.scenario-03-target: Signature verification proves that a message was authorized by the claimed validator and was not altered.
answers.scenario-03-control-after: Deterministic ordering ensures every honest node derives the same canonical result from the same inputs.
